items.stem: What is distinctive about BigQuery ML?

options.text: You create and run models using SQL inside BigQuery
options.rationale: Correct: BQML lets you build models with SQL where the data lives.

options.text: It requires exporting data to a separate notebook first
options.rationale: BQML runs inside BigQuery without exporting data.

options.text: It only supports deep neural networks
options.rationale: It supports many model types, not only DNNs.

items.explanation: Correct: BQML builds models with SQL inside BigQuery.

items.stem: Which function returns quality metrics for a trained BigQuery ML model?

options.rationale: CREATE MODEL trains; it does not report evaluation metrics.

items.explanation: Correct: ML.EVALUATE returns model quality metrics.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices help avoid misleading BigQuery ML results? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Evaluate on held-out data, not training data
options.rationale: Correct: held-out evaluation avoids over-optimistic metrics.

options.text: Exclude any feature that leaks the label
options.rationale: Correct: label leakage inflates apparent accuracy.

options.text: Score forever without retraining as data drifts
Judge the model on one lucky query
options.rationale: A single query is not a sound evaluation.

items.explanation: Correct: use held-out evaluation and avoid label leakage.
